payload.objective: Deliver the next serialized concrete provider adapter group after accepted IMP-PROV-04. Move Gemini, Kiro, and Pi live execution behind private Providers Execution adapters that implement the accepted Providers root protocol and shared conformance suite. Preserve observable invocation, streaming/final-result, negotiation/fallback where applicable, cancellation, timeout, safe diagnostics, provider-session reference, and failure behavior while deleting only the superseded Gemini/Kiro/Pi legacy branches.
scope: Use pkg/services/providers as the standalone owner and keep concrete implementations parent-private under Execution.
Gemini, Kiro, and Pi each load identity/capability metadata from the Providers-owned catalog and register through the accepted execution registry.
Preserve Gemini/Kiro/Pi command, decode/stream, session, failure, and timeout behavior with observable parity versus the transitional Workers packages.

Prove canonical request mapping, ordered progress/tool/message drafts, exactly one terminal result, cancellation/timeout normalization, safe diagnostics, and provider-session metadata through shared conformance and focused functional tests entered through root.BuildProcess.

Delete only Gemini/Kiro/Pi aggregate execution, decoding, failure, timeout, and session branches that are actually replaced; leave thin Workers integration shims only when required for transitional composition parity, matching the Cursor/OpenCode residual pattern.

Do not edit top-level CLI/Cobra composition, authored OpenAPI/generation, Packaged Factory catalog ownership, Provider Sessions readers, Models, Automations wire folds, or unrelated providers (Agy/PTY).
Treat shared coverage, ownership, and package-target manifest churn as accepted integration work; rebase and reconcile it through delivery.
acceptanceCriteria: Gemini, Kiro, and Pi execute only through their Providers-owned private adapters and the accepted Providers execution registry (behavioral)
Each adapter passes the shared provider conformance protocol plus focused public functional tests entered through root.BuildProcess (behavioral)
Streaming, final selection, tool correlation, negotiation/fallback where applicable, cancellation, timeout, normalized failures, and detached Provider Session references retain observable parity
No shared orchestration switch gains a new Gemini, Kiro, or Pi case, and replaced legacy branches are removed in the same slice
Workers transitional packages for Gemini/Kiro/Pi no longer own live execution bodies once Providers adapters are registered; any residual integration files are thin and non-authoritative
Shared coverage/ownership/package-target manifests are reconciled on the merged head
Required focused tests, package-boundary/file-count checks, relevant functional gates, and repository verification pass
Required CI is terminal green, blocking PR conversation comments are addressed, merge conflicts are resolved, and the PR is merged before Factory completion
antiPatterns: Starting IMP-PROV-06 Agy/PTY or LWR-PROV protocol adapters in this packet
Adding Gemini/Kiro/Pi cases to aggregate Workers conductor/provider_behavior switches instead of Providers adapters
Duplicating catalog metadata in Go instead of binding catalog identities through the accepted registry
Reopening Cursor/OpenCode/Claude/Codex adapter packages except for unavoidable shared harness/registry touch-ups
Treating green CI without merge as Factory completion
Holding the packet solely for shared coverage/ownership/package-target manifest churn
payload.deliveryContract: Continue the implementation and review loop until every required CI check is terminal and passing, every blocking PR conversation comment is addressed, merge conflicts are resolved, and the PR is merged. Only then may Factory work complete. Opening a PR, making it review-ready, or obtaining green CI without merge is not completion. Shared-file churn is not an admission blocker; rebase and reconcile shared files as part of this delivery loop.
payload.requestedOutcome: Implement IMP-PROV-05 by migrating Gemini, Kiro, and Pi live execution into parent-private Providers Execution adapters bound through the accepted catalog-backed execution registry. Preserve observable Gemini/Kiro/Pi request, stream, negotiation/fallback where applicable, tool/message correlation, final-result, cancellation, timeout, diagnostics, failure, and detached Provider Session reference behavior. Remove only aggregate legacy Gemini/Kiro/Pi branches superseded by the cutover. Do not admit IMP-PROV-06, LWR-PROV, Workers fold/DEL, Automations/Recordings/PSES wire folds, OpenAPI fan-in, or PSS-I03. Explicitly loop through implementation and review until required CI is terminal green, every blocking PR conversation comment is addressed, merge conflicts and shared-file churn are reconciled, the PR is merged, and only then complete the Factory work.
